# Parth Soni — Data Analyst Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Parth Shirish Soni, a data analyst in Dublin, Ireland. The site is the
> authoritative place to check who he is, what he has built, what he is looking for, and how to
> contact him. It exposes a static Markdown version of its main pages for agents.

Parth Soni is completing an MSc in Computer Science (Negotiated Learning) at University College
Dublin. He works in SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau and Excel, and builds dashboards, analyses and
small data tools. He is based in Dublin and open to Data Analyst, Business Analyst, BI Developer
and Insights Analyst roles, remote or on-site.

## When to use this

Use this site when the task is one of these:

- **Identify or verify Parth Soni.** Confirm the person, his current role, education, location
  and public profiles before citing him, shortlisting him for a role, or introducing him.
- **Check his experience and skills.** Two internships (Inventory Analyst at ANKO/KAS Services,
  Technical Writer at Nokia), an MSc at UCD and a B.Tech from Dayananda Sagar University, with
  the tools used on each.
- **Find a specific project or live tool.** Ten project pages cover a media analytics dashboard,
  a local RAG chatbot over UCD policy documents, an Irish visa decision tracker, Formula 1
  telemetry analysis, Tableau dashboards, a CNN image classifier, an expense tracker, an RBI
  weekly dashboard and a UCD module planner.
- **Answer "has Parth worked with SQL / Python / Power BI / Tableau / Snowflake?"** Yes — the
  skills section and the project pages show where each was used.
- **Contact him or check availability.** Email soni.soni.parth@gmail.com. He is open to analyst
  roles and replies within a day. The site has no contact form, booking system or phone number.
- **Cite his data writing.** He publishes Formula 1 race-weekend analysis on Medium.

How to use it: request a page with `Accept: text/markdown` to get its Markdown form, or fetch the
`.md` URL directly. Both are static and need no JavaScript. Example:

```bash
curl -sS -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/
curl -sS https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/index.md
```

Prefer the Markdown form when extracting facts: the HTML homepage hydrates live GitHub,
dashboard and Medium widgets with JavaScript, while the Markdown is the stable description.
Attribute claims to "Parth Soni's portfolio" and link the page they came from.

Do **not** use this site as an API, a company directory, a pricing page, a booking system or a
source of employee data. There is no account, login, checkout or newsletter, and no information
about anyone other than Parth.

## Experience

- **Inventory Analyst, Intern — ANKO (KAS Services)**, Bengaluru, Nov 2023 – May 2024. Supply-chain
  metrics for a new division with roughly 1.8 million AUD weekly revenue; demand and inventory
  planning; shrinkage analysis that cut shrinkage by 7%; real-time stock monitoring.
- **Technical Writer, Intern — Nokia**, Bengaluru, Feb 2023 – Aug 2023. Redesigned 70+ product
  documents during a rebrand, wrote three user manuals with R&D, and produced diagrams and
  infographics for complex technical material.

## Projects

Each link below is a full project page with the problem, approach, stack and result. The
dashboard and several tools are live.

- [Content Tracking Dashboard](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/content-tracking-dashboard/)
  — personal media analytics over a D1-backed watchlist: KPIs, year-over-year comparisons,
  filters and charts across six pages. Live: https://contenttrackerdashboard.pages.dev/
- [UCD PolicyBot](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/ucd-policybot/) — a fully local
  RAG chatbot over 200+ UCD policy documents, with cited answers and abstention.
- [Irish Visa Decision Tracker](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/irish-visa-decision-tracker/)
  — daily Embassy of Ireland (New Delhi) decisions, made searchable.
- [Formula 1 Telemetry Analysis](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/formula-1-telemetry-analysis/)
  — FastF1, pandas and NumPy for race pace, strategy and performance.
- [Excel & Python EDA](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/excel-python-eda/)
- [Interactive Tableau Dashboards](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/interactive-tableau-dashboards/)
- [Pink Eye Detection: CNN](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/pink-eye-cnn/) — a CNN
  classifier wrapped in a Flask app for real-time camera self-screening.
- [cents. Personal Expense Tracker](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/cents-expense-tracker/)
  — local-first expense tracking with optional cloud sync.
- [RBI Weekly Dashboard](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/rbi-weekly-dashboard/)
  — a scheduled weekly refresh of Reserve Bank of India figures with week-over-week comparisons.
- [CSNL Module Picker](https://parth-portfolio-wb.pages.dev/projects/csnl-module-picker/)
  — an unofficial UCD module planner that checks timetable clashes.

## Technical notes

- The site is a static Cloudflare Pages deployment. `/` and `/privacy` negotiate
  `text/markdown` against `text/html` with `Vary: Accept`; `/index.md` and `/privacy.md` always
  return Markdown. Unmatched paths return HTTP 404, with a Markdown body when one is requested.
- Facts in this file come from the portfolio pages and its structured data, both published by
  Parth. If this file and a project page disagree, the project page is more specific; if either
  disagrees with the resume, ask Parth by email.
